catalogue.fiche.vide: Choose a unit or an algorithm.
catalogue.index_catalogue.catalogue_priv: Import prive/unites/ (outside git): the choice also applies to the simulation palette
catalogue.page.description.content: Égide unit and algorithm sheets: fidelity, equations, assumptions, validity domain, sources and code.
catalogue.page.title: Égide — catalogue
page.aide.dd_12: Close the panel or the inspector
page.aide.dd_4: Turn sound effects on or off (off at start)
page.aide.li_4: Blue pulse: a radar reports drones to the CRC; white: the CRC sends an aircraft; yellow dashes: an aircraft locks a drone with its sensor
page.aide.li_5: Control centre (CRC) and links; red cross: link cut or aircraft out of reach
page.aide.li_9: Ground bubble, paler when short of ammunition
page.autoconfig.autoconfig_arreter.title: Stop the search
page.autoconfig.note: Give the threats to consider, the available assets and the area to defend: the tool places radars, centres, targets, posts, aircraft and defensive drones, tries several layouts in simulation and keeps the one that minimises hits (MODELE § 20).
page.autoconfig.tirages_autoconfig.texte: Raids per trial and per threat
page.balayage.note: Varies a setting and replays the raid over several seeds for each value. Each point is a mean; the vertical bar, its 95 % confidence interval.
page.barre_haut.direct.title: Each group comes from a different heading, in a tight wave.
page.barre_haut.disperse.title: Each drone comes alone, from anywhere, with staggered departures.
page.barre_haut.editer.title: At the start of the raid: place targets, radars, aircraft, flight plan and zones. Paused during the raid: give orders to aircraft. (E)
page.barre_haut.essaim_reactif.title: The swarm learns from its losses: it leaves deadly targets for those already hit, bypasses defended sites and dodges air fire (MODELE § 22). (R)
page.barre_haut.fourmi.title: The whole swarm enters through a tight corridor, then bursts towards its targets.
page.barre_haut.lien_catalogue.title: Unit and algorithm sheets: equations, assumptions, sources, code
page.barre_haut.observer.title: Watch the raid in 3D on the globe, each unit at its true altitude (O)
page.barre_haut.plan_de_vol.title: The swarm follows the flight plan drawn in the editor, then heads for its targets.
page.barre_haut.tactiques.title: Swarm tactic
page.barre_haut.vue_pc.title: Switch between ground truth and what the control centre knows: known drones and tracks (V)
page.debriefing.note: Read from the log of the finished raid: what got through, why, and where the defence weakened (MODELE § 28).
page.globe.div.aria_label: 3D view of the raid on the globe
page.journal.note: What the engine has done up to now, most recent first: a radar sees, the information reaches the CRC, the CRC sends an aircraft, the aircraft receives its mission, locks a drone with its sensor, fires. Click a line to inspect the unit.
page.page.aimantation.title: Snap placements to a grid or to nearby units
page.page.annuler_edition.title: Undo the last gesture (Ctrl+Z)
page.page.autre_graine.title: Draw another seed
page.page.camera_3d.title: Where to put the observer; click a unit to choose which one to follow or which radar to look from
page.page.debut.aria_label: Back to the start of the raid
page.page.debut.title: Back to the start
page.page.description.content: Territorial air defence against a swarm of fast drones: radars, orbiting aircraft, ground air-defence posts.
page.page.exageration_3d.title: Stretch the terrain and the altitude of flying units to read them from afar: display only, the computation does not depend on it
page.page.exporter_deploiement.title: Download the complete scenario (JSON)
page.page.gomme.title: Erase the clicked unit (X)
page.page.graine.title: Random seed: the same seed replays the same raid
page.page.importer_deploiement.title: Reload an exported scenario
page.page.liaison.title: Link two units (L)
page.page.mesure.title: Measure distance and heading (M)
page.page.mettre_hors_service.title: Take the selection out of service, at this instant (Del)
page.page.moyen_liaison.title: Means of the next link; it overrides the units' declared equipment
page.page.nom_deploiement.aria_label: Name of the deployment to save
page.page.p: Move the map: drag the background, or arrow keys, or Space + drag. Zoom: wheel.
page.page.p_2: Place: click a unit in the panel, then the map; right-click to finish.
page.page.p_3: Select: click; Shift+drag for a box; Ctrl+1 to 9 makes a group, 1 to 9 recalls it.
page.page.p_4: Equip: drop a means or a weapon on an already placed unit. Erase: Del, Eraser (X) or Shift+click while placing.
page.page.plan.title: Draw the swarm's flight plan (P)
page.page.ranger_deploiement.title: Store the complete scenario in this browser's library
page.page.reseau_auto.title: Link each equipped unit to the C2 centres it shares a means in range with
page.page.reseau_complet.title: Everyone talks to everyone, with no delay
page.page.retablir_edition.title: Redo the undone gesture (Ctrl+Y)
page.page.selection.title: Select and move (S)
page.page.son.title: Turn the raid's sound effects on or off (M)
page.page.title: Égide
page.page.tout_effacer.title: Clear the map (Ctrl+Z to go back)
page.page.zone.title: Draw a protected zone (Z)
page.palette.famille_aide: The theatre is the disc your units defend; the swarm attacks it from outside.
page.palette.placer_theatre: Pick the centre on the map
page.palette.recherche_palette.aria_labe: Search the catalogue for a unit
page.profil.note_profil: Draw a flight plan in the editor (Flight plan tool) to see its profile.
page.rail.aide.title: Controls and symbols (7)
page.rail.autoconfig.title: Auto-configuration: threats, assets, area, optimised layout (6)
page.rail.balayage.title: Sweep a setting over several raids (3)
page.rail.calques.title: Layers and base map (2)
page.rail.debriefing.title: Raid debriefing: score, causes of hits, weak points (8)
page.rail.journal.title: Who saw what, who told whom, when (5)
page.rail.profil.title: Flight plan profile above the terrain (4)
page.rail.scenario.title: Scenario settings (1)
page.scenario.bibliotheque.aria_label: Load a scenario from the library
page.scenario.conduite_ciblee.texte: The CRC is a swarm target
page.scenario.conduite_ciblee.title: The control centre becomes a target of the swarm; it is destroyed at the first hit (MODELE § 15.4).
page.scenario.exporter_rejeu.title: Simulate the raid and download its replay (.egide-rejeu), to replay in a game engine
page.scenario.importer_scenario.title: Reload an exported scenario (JSON)
page.scenario.ligne.title: Incidents drawn from the raid seed: radars hampered by weather or under maintenance, links cut, batteries unavailable (MODELE § 29)
page.scenario.nom_prereglage.aria_label: Name of the settings to save
page.scenario.terrain.title: Theatre terrain: it masks radars and radio links (MODELE § 16). To build a real terrain: node outils/terrain.js.
page.scope.canvas.aria_label: Picture: defended area, radars, aircraft, drones, targets
vue.app.aucune_liaison: No link possible: equip the units and at least one C2 centre with a common means (Network tab of the palette).

vue.app.bandeau_pc.one: CRC view: {n} drone known out of {en_vol} airborne
vue.app.bandeau_pc.other: CRC view: {n} drones known out of {en_vol} airborne

vue.app.carte_webgl: Map unavailable in this browser (WebGL): scope view only.
vue.app.profil_vide: Draw a flight plan of at least two points in the editor to see its profile.
vue.app.range_bibliotheque: “{nom}” stored in the library: Scenario panel to reload it.
vue.app.refus_stockage: This browser refuses to save: export the scenario.
vue.app.rejeu_calcul: Simulating the raid for the replay…
vue.app.rejeu_exporte: Replay exported: {images} frames, {duree} s of raid.
vue.app.son_actif: Sound effects on: click to turn them off (M)
vue.app.son_coupe: Sound effects off: click to turn them on (M)
vue.autoconfig.choisir_zone: Choose an area: a country, or an area drawn in the editor.
vue.autoconfig.indiscernable: not yet significant: increase the raids per trial
vue.autoconfig.radars_pousses: pushed {pc} of their range beyond the border
vue.autoconfig.resultat: {meilleur} hits on average with the layout kept, against {uniforme} with a uniform layout: difference {ecart} ± {ic} (95 % CI, {n} paired raids), {verdict}.
vue.autoconfig.sans_frontieres: Borders missing: run node outils/frontieres.js, or use a drawn area.
vue.autoconfig.strategie: aircraft at {avions} of the way from the centre to the border, defensive drones at {drones} of the radius around the targets, radars {radars}
vue.autoconfig.uniforme: uniform: orbits drawn at random over the theatre disc

vue.catalogue.fusion.one: {n} private unit added to the public catalogue.
vue.catalogue.fusion.other: {n} private units added to the public catalogue.

vue.catalogue.index_prive_illisible: private index unreadable ({erreur}): run node outils/indexer.js
vue.catalogue.refus_stockage: This browser refuses to remember the choice (local storage unavailable).

vue.catalogue.remplacement.one: {n} private unit, replacing the public units of its folder.
vue.catalogue.remplacement.other: {n} private units, replacing the public units of their folders.

vue.consigne.centre: Click: add a C2 centre · right-click: finish
vue.consigne.cible: Click: add a site to defend · right-click: finish
vue.consigne.depot: {nom}: click to place · drag a unit: move it · drag the background: move the map · right-click to finish
vue.consigne.gomme: Click a unit: erase it · right-click: finish
vue.consigne.liaison_premiere: {moyen}: click the first unit to link · the means is changed next to the Link button
vue.consigne.liaison_seconde: {moyen} from {origine}: click the second unit · Esc: cancel
vue.consigne.ordres: Click or box aircraft, then right-click to send them

vue.consigne.ordres_choisis.one: {n} unit: right-click to send · Del to take out of service
vue.consigne.ordres_choisis.other: {n} units: right-click to send · Del to take out of service

vue.consigne.plan: Click: add a flight-plan point · right-click: finish
vue.consigne.radar: Click: add a radar · right-click: finish
vue.consigne.selection: Click: pick a unit · drag a unit: move it · drag the background: move the map · Shift+drag: selection box
vue.consigne.theatre: Click the future centre of the theatre · right-click: cancel
vue.consigne.zone: Click: add a vertex · double-click or Enter: close the zone · Esc: cancel
vue.editeur.aucune_unite: No unit here: aim at a radar, a centre, a site, a battery or an aircraft.
vue.editeur.carte_videe: Map cleared: the main CRC and one site to defend remain. Ctrl+Z (Undo) goes back.
vue.editeur.cdc_ineffacable: The main CRC cannot be erased: move it.
vue.editeur.deposer_sur_unite: {nom}: drop it on an already placed unit (and not the same means twice).
vue.editeur.dernier_site: This unit cannot be erased (at least one site to defend is needed).
vue.editeur.rien_a_effacer: Nothing to erase here: aim at a unit.
vue.fiche.note_batterie: Range {km} km, Pk {pk}. Attached to the nearest site for the network.

vue.fiche.note_groupe.one: {n} vehicle. Ctrl+1 to 9 stores a selection, 1 to 9 recalls it.
vue.fiche.note_groupe.other: {n} vehicles. Ctrl+1 to 9 stores a selection, 1 to 9 recalls it.

vue.fiche.note_site: Its common ground posts form the network node “posts of C{n}”.
vue.fiche.radars_frontiere: Radars spread along the border: their model is common. Move or drop a radar to place them one by one and choose each model.
vue.infobulle.radar_frontiere: part of the border coverage (moving it places it)
vue.infobulle.ralliement: en route to its station point
vue.infobulle.reseau_complet: full network: everyone is linked, with no delay
vue.journal_console.carte: Map unavailable, back to the scope: {erreur}
vue.palette.avions_aide: Interceptors: one aircraft per drop (or the chosen quantity), orbiting at the dropped point.
vue.palette.capteurs_aide: Radars: each keeps its model, range and antenna height.
vue.palette.drones_defensifs_aide: Defensive swarms: armed, kamikaze interceptors, jammers.
vue.palette.effecteurs_aide: Drop on an aircraft or a defensive drone: its group changes payload.
vue.palette.hors_portee: {moyen} reaches {portee} km; {de} and {vers} are {distance} km apart. Choose a longer-range means, or go through a relay.
vue.palette.infrastructures_aide: Sensitive sites to defend and C2 centres (CRC).
vue.palette.liaisons_aide: Click a means, then the two units to link. Dragging a means onto a unit equips it, for “Link automatically”.
vue.palette.meme_unite: It is the same unit: click the other end of the link.
vue.palette.menace_aide: Drone model of the enemy swarm (wherever it is dropped).
vue.palette.sol_aide: Ground air-defence batteries, placed one by one, attached to the nearest site.
vue.profil.sans_relief: Terrain unavailable (offline or source missing): only the flight altitude is drawn.
vue.reglages.vitesse_drones_def: Speed of armed drones and jammers
vue.tableau.essaim_reactif: Reactive swarm: {reaffectations} reassignments · {detours} detours · {esquives} shots dodged
